decision.reason: Unchanged full raw-matrix and independent energy gates pass for every bounded endpoint; retain all first-observed and primed samples. No broad performance-promotion claim.

reproduction.prerequisites: Run on the node2 Slurm submission host. CUDA12.9.1/sm120, CMake/Ninja, verified compiler cache, build-time compiler Python dependencies, pinned GPU4PySCF/PySCF/CuPy versions from samples. Set BASELINE_CHECKOUT/CANDIDATE_CHECKOUT/REFERENCE_PYTHON and reference shared-library paths. Native children require neither Python nor compiler discovery. Standalone reproduction script syntax checked, not independently replayed.
reproduction.source_restore: Retain this bundle outside both clean source checkouts before restoring the two recorded revisions. Full default AOT closure required. For independent qualification also build generativeqc_cuda_wb97mv_nuclear_jk_probe, generativeqc_ks_wb97mv_hessian_probe and generativeqc_ks_wb97mv_grid_probe; set their GENERATIVEQC_*_PROBE paths, GENERATIVEQC_LIBRARY, PYTHONPATH=python:tests/python:. and GENERATIVEQC_STATIONARY_RECEIPTS, then run tests/python/test_native_wb97mv_nuclear_jk.py and test_native_wb97mv_stationary.py through a finite srun, preserving visibility. The latter retains both .004/.002 energy stencils and unmodified acceptance gates. Public frontend qualification uses test_wb97mv_hessian_cli_cuda.py with GENERATIVEQC_WB97MV_HESSIAN_CUDA_TEST=1, GENERATIVEQC_TEST_NATIVE_HESSIAN_FRONTEND=1 and GENERATIVEQC_WB97MV_CLI. Earlier unchanged leaf inventory qualification remains separately identified in the source17/default-fg publications, not relabeled as a new run.
